title: successorAuthorisation
description: The request body of EP-SUCCESSOR-AUTHORISATION (section 10.2 of the implementation specification).

authorisationRef.description: The reference of the written authorisation of the successor, which holds no name of a person.

validFrom.description: The first day on which the authorisation is in force.

validTo.description: The last day on which the authorisation is in force, not before validFrom.
